field_meaning.designations: HPSAs with status Designated, any type.
field_meaning.geographic: Geographic and high-needs geographic HPSAs: a whole area short of dentists.
field_meaning.population_groups: Population HPSAs: a group (usually low-income or Medicaid-eligible residents) short of dentists.
field_meaning.facilities: Facility HPSAs: health centres, rural health clinics, tribal and correctional facilities.
field_meaning.people_covered: Sum of the designation population of geographic and population HPSAs.
field_meaning.dentists_needed: Sum of HPSA Shortage: full-time dentists needed to remove those designations.
field_meaning.top_designations: Geographic and population HPSAs with the highest HPSA score, by name.
field_meaning.top_counties: Counties touched by a geographic or population HPSA, highest HPSA score first (scores run 0-26; higher is a greater shortage).

limits: A designation is a federal shortage finding, not a statement that no dentist is taking patients.
Withdrawn and proposed-for-withdrawal designations are not counted.
Facility designations are counted but not summed into people covered.
